items.text: Fitness training can be a good career for people who enjoy coaching and can build a client base, but income is uneven early, qualification quality varies and safety and scope limits matter, so test it with real clients and check certifications before paying.
Learn safe coaching basics, practise with real clients under supervision and build repeat clients and referrals before expecting stable income.
Check the recognition of any course and refer medical issues to qualified professionals.
